scope: Combat domain scan after primary 43-entry purge, status-effect residual migration, Loop 5 target/armor writer-lock audit, Loop 6 atomic side-state fail-closed audit, and Loop 7 ingress reject lock-nesting audit
loop5AdditionalFindings: RegisterTarget/UnregisterTarget/SyncTargetHealth/SyncTargetProtection/SyncTargetHitProfile wrote DataVault-backed target arrays without a dedicated writer window.
TryQueueDamage refreshed target hit profile from managed receiver/Transform before ingress locks.
RefreshArmorTargetSnapshots ran before armor buffer pinning in damage/status/armor evaluator paths.
LateFrame dispatch wrote counters/status-active/telemetry after job pin locks were released.
Queue reject anomaly publication did not write a black-box telemetry ring entry.
loop6AdditionalFindings: SeedTargetArmorProfile, RefreshTargetArmorBase, ResetStatusEffectSlot, and ClearSlot-adjacent helper routes could previously fail silently when a DataVault write lock was unavailable.
UnregisterTarget could tombstone BallisticsRuntime primitives before side-state locks had succeeded, leaving a still-registered target without its ballistic primitive on lock contention.
Moving status and armor side-state through independent helper calls was not atomic enough: one domain could be copied/cleared while the other domain failed.
loop7AdditionalFindings: TryQueueDamage post-lock storage rejection published queue reject telemetry while ingress write locks were still held. This was not a guaranteed deadlock, but it nested telemetry lock acquisition inside ingress locks without a need.

remediation.armorTargetLocks: HectonCombatRuntime_ArmorPenetration.cs:770-799 plus finally sites at 1082,1104,1169 and combined side-state finally sites in CombatDamageRuntime_StatusEffects.cs:1308,1358
remediation.atomicSideState: CombatDamageRuntime_StatusEffects.cs:1255-1365 MoveTargetSideState/ClearTargetSideState acquire status + armor locks, validate both storage domains, mutate after validation, and release both domains in finally.
remediation.failClosedCallSites: CombatDamageRuntime.cs:467,490,556,644,2140 consume bool helper results instead of ignoring failed locks.
remediation.ballisticsTombstoneOrdering: CombatDamageRuntime.cs:584-588 tombstones BallisticsRuntime primitives only after ClearSlot and RebuildTargetLookup succeed.
remediation.dispatchRetryPin: CombatDamageRuntime.cs:1284-1303, pending flags retry if dispatch lock cannot be acquired
remediation.queueRejectBlackBox: CombatDamageRuntime.cs:1707-1767 records dropped packet anomalies under telemetry write locks
remediation.ingressRejectLockNesting: CombatDamageRuntime.cs:762-789 defers post-lock storage reject telemetry until after ReleaseDamageIngressWriteLocks has run.
remediation.hotPathRefreshRemoval: TryQueueDamage no longer calls RefreshTargetHitProfile; owner phase must publish hit profile through SyncTargetHitProfile.
